topic: Cost of growing in place in Puget Sound (Bellevue / Eastside / South King County) for Integra Dental Design: rent, WA taxes, payroll loads, wages, sales-rep comp, incremental equipment, local marketing, shipping/courier
summary:
Bottom line for a skeptical reader: growing in place is cheap on taxes and payroll loads, expensive on rent-per-foot and on the one thing Integra actually lacks (sales capacity). The numbers below are as of 2026-10-12.

FACTS (primary sources). Rent: Integra's $2,300/mo for ~600 SF is $3.83/SF/mo all-in, well above market for flex. The Tukwila Seattle Exchange park (Lee & Associates, CBA listings modified 8/14 and 9/22/2026) is asking $2.10/SF/mo blended, modified gross ($2,961/mo for 1,410 SF; $4,450/mo for 2,119 SF) with a published promo of $1.00/SF/mo for the first year on eligible suites. Redmond Willows flex asks $1.80-$2.04/SF/mo NNN with 2026 NNN of $0.57 (95th Street Tech Center) or $2.40/SF gross on a short-term sublease (WillowsFlex, Sept 2026-Oct 2027). Kent Valley small bays go for $1.55 NNN; Kidder Mathews Q2 2026 puts Eastside direct asking at $1.88 NNN vs Southend $1.01-$1.05, with Eastside vacancy 6.0% and regional 9.5% (tenant-favorable; landlords trading concessions for occupancy). Bellevue office/retail small suites on 148th Ave SE run $34/SF/yr + ~$10.80 NNN (about $3.73/SF/mo).

Taxes: WAC 458-20-151 classifies lab fabrication as manufacturing (0.484%) plus retailing (0.471%, sales to dentists) or wholesaling (0.484%, lab-to-lab with reseller permit), with the MATC so tax is paid once; rates rise to 0.50% on 1/1/2027 (ESHB 2081). Dental prostheses are sales-tax exempt (RCW 82.08.0283) and mills/furnaces/printers qualify for the M&E exemption (RCW 82.08.02565), worth 10.3% in Bellevue. The small-business B&O credit ($55/mo for non-service filers, RCW 82.04.4451) wipes out state B&O at Integra's current ~$140k/yr and phases out around $280k/yr. Bellevue adds a city B&O of 0.1596% above $215,000 taxable receipts, a square-footage tax of $0.3297475/sq ft/quarter on support/out-of-city-sales space, and a $119 license. Service revenue (training, design-only) is 1.5%.

Payroll: L&I class 3602 (dental labs) 2026 composite is $0.4056/hr, of which $0.13195 is the employee deduction, so the employer's net is about $0.27/hr ($570/FTE/yr). PFML is 1.13% but the employer share applies only at 50+ employees; WA Cares (0.58%) is employee-paid. State minimum wage is $17.13 (2026) and $17.73 (2027); Bellevue has no local minimum, while Seattle ($21.30), Tukwila ($21.65) and Renton ($20.57-$21.57) do. The 2026 exempt-salary floor is $80,168.40, which constrains a salaried CAD/CAM director, and the noncompete floor is $126,858.83, so a sales rep's noncompete is unenforceable.

Wages: BLS OEWS May 2025 (via BLS-derived mirrors) shows WA dental lab techs at $56,400 median ($27.12/hr), P10 $39,970 to P90 $78,340, with 670 jobs statewide and 380 in the Seattle MSA (median $57,610). Live King County postings cluster at $20-$25/hr entry (Novus, Nuvia), $22-$35 (MicroDental/DiMartino, Renton) and $25-$38 (Bellevue removables).

Sales reps: posted structures are $60-$75k base plus 5-6% of net sales (DCS, MRM), $60k base plus $250-$750 per new account (Ziemek), or 100% commission at 8% year-one and 3% residual (Ultra Core). LMT's 40/60 fixed/commission guideline is 2011-vintage. Expect $85-$110k loaded year one for a Puget Sound rep, before any sales.

Equipment list prices: Dekema 674i $14,582-$15,999; used Programat P710 $5,700-$6,000; Asiga MAX UV $8,990, MAX 2 UV $9,990-$10,990; a third ARUM mill $51,000 list (A3L) or $17,500 at demo/dealer cost, versus Versamill 5X200 at $103,600 with install/training.

Marketing: LMT LAB DAY West (May 14-15, 2027) does not publish booth prices. The WSDLA/Oregon labs' Pacific Northwest Conference (2027 in Seattle) sells tables at $1,050-$1,250 and program sponsorship at $1,200. SKCDS and WSDA PNDC do not publish rates. WordStream's 2026 benchmark CPC for dentists is $8.00 (no dental-lab-specific CPC exists). Marketing Mail letters cost $0.339-$0.372 postage; small-run postcards cost $0.85-$1.50 all-in.

Shipping: nearest UPS Store (14150 NE 20th St) Air cutoff 4:30 PM M-F; FedEx Office 40 Bellevue Way Express pickup 4:35 PM M-F; Crossroads/Factoria FedEx Office cutoffs unconfirmed. Seattle Messenger Co-op zone prices (from downtown): Bellevue $34.97, Tukwila $31.13, Renton $37.83, Redmond $43.12 standard, 1.5x priority, 2x rush, +20% fuel.

ESTIMATES (labeled): lab build-out $10-60k; personal property tax ~$1.4-1.7k/yr; dental-lab Google CPC $3-$8; trade-show 10x10 $2.5-4k; dedicated courier route $12-35/stop.

UNKNOWNS: LMT and PNDC booth prices, SUTA rate, Bellevue square-footage tax applicability to production floor, CAM license cost for a third mill, FedEx Ship Center late cutoff, and actual OEWS percentile table for the Seattle MSA (BLS pages blocked crawlers; mirrors used).

Judgment: the binding constraints are not occupancy or tax. At $11,700/mo revenue the state B&O is already zero and L&I is a rounding error; adding 1,000-1,500 SF of flex space costs $1,900-$5,700/mo, which is 16-49% of current monthly collections, so it only makes sense after volume, not before. The single largest incremental cost of growing in place is a salesperson ($85-110k/yr loaded), and the mills' 90% idle time means no equipment spend is justified until utilization exceeds roughly 50%.

findings.claim: Dental lab fabrication is a manufacturing activity for WA B&O; sales also taxed under retailing or wholesaling with the Multiple Activities Tax Credit; prostheses are sales-tax exempt
findings.detail: WAC 458-20-151(3)(a): 'The production or fabrication of dental appliances, devices, restorations, substitutes, or other dental laboratory products by dental laboratories and dental technicians is a manufacturing activity. RCW 82.04.120.' Labs must report under manufacturing and under wholesaling or retailing; MATC may be claimed (WAC 458-20-19301). Sales of prostheses meeting the 'prosthetic device' definition are exempt from retail sales tax (crowns, inlays, dentures etc. listed). Dentists' in-house fabrication is not manufacturing. DOR denturist guide: report sales to dentists under Retailing B&O and Retail Sales tax, then take the 'Prescription Drugs/Hearing Aids/Lenses/Etc.' deduction when the dentist supplies the Sales Tax Exemption Certificate for Health Care Providers with 'Dental prostheses' checked; wholesale sales to other labs need a reseller permit. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: 2026 WA B&O rates: Manufacturing 0.484%, Wholesaling 0.484%, Retailing 0.471%, Service & Other 1.5% (<$1M), 1.75% ($1M-$5M), 2.1% ($5M+)
findings.detail: DOR 'Business & occupation tax classifications' table: Manufacturing .00484, Retailing .00471, Wholesaling .00484, Service & other activities .015/.0175/.021 by prior-year taxable income. DOR special notice (issued July 25, 2025) confirms the three service tiers effective Oct 1, 2025. Integra's training/installation/design-only revenue would fall under Service & Other at 1.5%. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Manufacturing, wholesaling and retailing B&O rates rise to 0.50% effective January 1, 2027 (ESHB 2081, 2025 session)
findings.detail: BDO, Greenberg Traurig, Moss Adams and Ballard Spahr summaries of ESHB 2081 (Chapter 240, Laws of 2025) state retailing moves from 0.471% to 0.50% and manufacturing/wholesaling from 0.484% to 0.50% on 1/1/2027 (permanent). DOR special-notice page for the 2027 change not located; law-firm summaries used. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Small Business B&O Tax Credit: max $55/month for non-service filers ($165/qtr, $660/yr) and $160/month for service filers, fully offsetting B&O at or below the cap and phasing out at 2x the cap
findings.detail: DOR notice 'Business and occupation tax credit increase for small businesses' (filing periods on/after Jan 1, 2023): $160/month max for businesses with 50%+ of income in Service & Other Activities etc.; $55/month for all other classifications; auto-calculated when filing electronically; RCW 82.04.4451. For Integra (manufacturing/retailing/wholesaling), $55/mo covers B&O on about $11,400-$11,700/mo of receipts at 0.471-0.484% and phases out when monthly B&O reaches $110 (~$23,000/mo revenue). SB 6346 (signed 3/30/2026) would raise caps to $125/$375 on 1/1/2029 only if the new >$1M income tax survives litigation and Initiative 645 (Nov 3, 2026 ballot). Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Dental prostheses sold to dentists are exempt from WA retail sales tax under RCW 82.08.0283 (prosthetic devices)
findings.detail: RCW 82.08.0283(1)(a): sales tax does not apply to 'prosthetic devices prescribed, fitted, or furnished for an individual by a person licensed under the laws of this state to prescribe, fit, or furnish prosthetic devices, and the components of such prosthetic devices'; (4)(a) defines prosthetic device as a replacement, corrective or supportive device worn on or in the body. WAC 458-20-18801 also referenced by WAC 458-20-151. Bellevue combined sales tax is 10.3% (SalesTaxHandbook 2026), so the exemption is material on $129-$2,200 units. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Mills, furnaces and printers used directly in manufacturing qualify for the WA manufacturer's machinery & equipment sales/use tax exemption (RCW 82.08.02565 / WAC 458-20-13601)
findings.detail: RCW 82.08.02565(1)(a): no sales tax on sales to a manufacturer of machinery and equipment used directly in a manufacturing operation, including installation/repair labor; M&E must have useful life of one year or more; buyer gives seller a Manufacturer's Sales and Use Tax Exemption Certificate. DOR denturist guide confirms: 'You do not have to pay sales or use tax on machinery and equipment used to make dentures and other products that you sell.' Note: when Integra sells an ARUM mill to a dentist, the dentist is not a manufacturer (WAC 458-20-151(3)(b)) and sales tax applies; sales to other labs can be exempt with certificate. On a $51,000 A3L at 10.3% the exemption is worth ~$5,250. Accessed 2026-10-12.
findings.value: 0% sales tax on qualifying lab equipment (saves 10.3%)

findings.claim: City of Bellevue levies its own B&O tax: 0.1596% of gross receipts above $215,000 taxable receipts, a square footage tax of $0.3297475/sq ft/quarter on qualifying office/support space, and a $119 business license registration (2026)
findings.detail: Bellevue 2026 B&O Tax Guide (Jan 1, 2026) per city PDF: gross receipts rate .1596%, tax due for businesses with annual taxable receipts over $215,000. City square footage page: 2026 rate $0.3297475 per taxable square foot per quarter ($329.74/qtr per 1,000 SF), applies to administrative/support space and space supporting sales delivered outside the city, with exemption for offices of 250 sq ft or less and deduction for the share of space supporting in-city gross-receipts-taxed activity. Business license fee for 2026: $119 (no annual renewal). Integra at ~$140k/yr is below the $215k gross-receipts threshold today; crossing it would add ~$480/yr per $300k of receipts. Applicability of the square footage tax to production floor (vs office) and interaction with the threshold should be confirmed with the Tax Division (tax@bellevuewa.gov). Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: WA L&I risk class 3602 ('Electronic Products, Jewelry and Instrument Mfg, Dental Labs'; subclass 3602-05 dental laboratories) 2026 composite base rate is $0.4056 per hour worked, up 6% from $0.3826 in 2025
findings.detail: L&I 2026 Rates by Business Type and Class Code: class 3602, 11,799 FTEs, 2025 composite $0.3826, 2026 $0.4056 (+6%). L&I 2026 Hourly Rates by Class Code and Fund: 3602 Accident Fund $0.1417, Stay-at-Work $0.0021, Medical Aid $0.0706, Supplemental Pension $0.1912, composite $0.4056, employee payroll deduction $0.13195/hr. Employer net ≈ $0.2737/hr ≈ $569/yr per 2,080-hr FTE (employee pays ≈ $274). WAC 296-17A-3602-05 covers 'Dental shops, laboratories, or kiosks' making dentures, artificial teeth, braces, retainers. Comparators: 4904 clerical $0.2223/hr; 6303 outside sales $0.3019/hr; 6109 physicians/dental clinics $0.5139. Statewide average increase 4.9%; base rates assume experience factor 1.0. Proposed 2027 rates are posted on L&I site. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: WA Paid Family & Medical Leave 2026 premium is 1.13% of wages (up from 0.92%), split 28.57% employer / 71.43% employee, but employers under 50 employees owe no employer share
findings.detail: ESD release Oct 29, 2025: 'The premium rate will be 1.13%... Employers will pay 28.57% of the total premium and employees will pay 71.43%... Businesses classified by Employment Security as having fewer than 50 employees are not required to pay the employer portion of the premium, unless they opt to do so. However, they must still collect the employee premium or pay employees' premiums on their behalf.' Wage cap $184,500 (Social Security base). For Integra (6 people): employer cost $0 unless it chooses to cover the 0.807% employee share. Accessed 2026-10-12.
findings.value: 1.13% total; employer share 0.323% only if 50+ employees; employee share 0.807%

findings.claim: WA Cares Fund premium is 0.58% of gross wages, employee-paid, no wage cap, employer remits only
findings.detail: WA Cares employer page: 'The premium is 0.58% of an employee's gross wages... You won't pay any share of these contributions for your employees; you may, however, elect to pay some or all of your employees' share on their behalf.' Not capped at the Social Security maximum. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: WA minimum wage is $17.13/hr in 2026 and $17.73/hr in 2027; Bellevue, Kirkland and Redmond have no local minimum, while Seattle ($21.30), Tukwila ($21.65), Renton ($21.57 large / $20.57 then $21.57 mid-size from 7/1/2026), Burien and unincorporated King County ($18.32-$20.82) exceed it

Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Lee & Associates' Q2 2026 Puget Sound report shows regional industrial vacancy 10.1% and average NNN asking $14.83/SF/yr (~$1.24/mo); Newmark shows 10.4% vacancy, $12.73/SF/yr NNN; all brokerages describe tenants holding leverage with concessions and flexible terms
findings.detail: Lee & Associates Pacific Northwest Q2 2026 market report: 12-month net absorption (2.01M SF), vacancy 10.1% (up from 9.7%), avg NNN asking $14.83 PSF/yr, under construction 1.93M SF. Cushman: Seattle $1.04/SF/mo NNN, vacancy 9.4%, effective rents under pressure from concessions, shorter terms and termination rights. Implication: a 1,000-2,000 SF flex tenant can negotiate free rent/TI in 2026. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Integra's current occupancy cost ($2,300/mo for ~600 SF, month-to-month) equals $3.83/SF/mo all-in, roughly 1.6-2.0x Eastside flex asking rents on a per-foot basis but with no lease commitment

findings.claim: Estimated fully loaded employer cost of a full-time dental technician in Bellevue is about 1.10x base wage (FICA 7.65% + L&I ~$0.27/hr + state UI est. ~1.3% on first ~$78k), excluding benefits
